sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r16/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: Quality Checks row 6 (check 5) and Internal Quality Checks row 6 (same text, no cell comments); Deterministic Checks row 14 (check-instruction-hygiene.py)
.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r16/task/tests/**/*.md and *.toml (machine-compared against the public text for ids, literals and verbatim overlap; functional judge.toml ids inspected)
evidence: Static row; decided on the frozen bytes, no runtime evidence is required for it. (1) The skill's grep for this check, widened by me (judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score\.py|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel plus gate|probe|grader|verifier|oracle|cw_|polish|functional|visual, case-insensitive) returns zero matches across task/instruction.md, all six task/environment/instructions/*.md and task/environment/assets/seed_data.json. (2) Criterion ids: 64 identifier-shaped tokens extracted from tests/**/*.md and *.toml (e.g. functional judge.toml:24 'cw_custom_typing_and_line_join') - none occurs in the public text. (3) Sentinels/probe literals: 88 quoted or backticked literals of 4-80 characters extracted from the judge prompts, app_context and judge.toml files; the only one present in the public text is the ordinary word 'saved'. No GATE-PROBE-style value is public. (4) Verbatim overlap: no run of 8 or more consecutive words is shared between any public file and any file under tests/. (5) Manual read: instruction.md is three first-person paragraphs ('I'd like a small local playground...', 'Please read the six notes in /instructions before building', 'Put the app in /app and serve the workspace at /'); the only paths named are /instructions, /assets/seed_data.json and /app, all agent-visible. The notes state product behaviour and the launch contract (integration.md:3 'node /app/server.js ... port 3000 ... GET /api/health'; integration.md:9 DB_PATH) without saying who checks it, how it is scored, or with what weights. policy.md:5 'Use the public behaviour in these notes as the contract. The examples are ways to explain it, not exact selectors, CSS classes or implementation requirements' speaks of the product contract and names no grader. Adversarial reading: a builder cannot learn from these files any criterion id, dimension name, weight, floor, judge model, tool name, test path or probe value, so nothing here lets a broken app target the grader, and no conforming app is disadvantaged by this row. Notes: (a) the launch contract and health route in integration.md are the template's runtime contract and belong to other rows, not a leak; (b) the two frozen workbook copies have different SHA256 (rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx 6d44970b..., skill assets/WebDev_Rubrics_QC.xlsx d7b5d607...) but the row 5 text is identical in both, so this row is unaffected; (c) check-instruction-hygiene.py itself was not executed (not available); its documented behaviour was applied by hand, which is not a portal checker run; (d) all 22 artifact hashes in raw-evidence-index.json match current bytes (hosted-run JSON after LF normalisation); none of that evidence is needed for or changes this row; (e) I did not independently recompute the input SHA256 of the frozen snapshot.
